claim: Core ComfyUI must not make outbound internet requests; uploads, telemetry, analytics, tracking, update checks and similar paths are refused.
execution.py consumes the prompt graph and execution-relevant state, produces execution results and errors, and must not know workflow ids, frontend ids, persistence ids, or API-only concepts.
ComfyUI models are always treated as frozen for inference; freeze/unfreeze/trainability toggles must not be added to model classes.

Optimized backend functions, dispatch helpers and capability-selected callables are opaque; higher-level code must not inspect function identity, names, modules, or implementation details to decide behavior.
Node-level code must not patch model code directly; any node behavior that modifies model behavior must go through the model patcher class.
validate_prompt(prompt_id, prompt, partial_execution_list) validates the prompt graph before execution.
execution.py defines ExecutionResult, DuplicateNodeError, and CacheEntry/CacheType/CacheSet caching primitives for prompt execution.
comfy_execution/graph.py likely holds the graph data structures that execution.py consumes; responsibility split between execution.py and comfy_execution/ is not yet confirmed.
PromptServer owns the API and websocket surface, including websocket_handler and add_routes.
VRAMState and CPUState enums model device memory policy states in comfy/model_management.py.
free_memory and load_models_gpu own GPU loading/offloading policy; memory management lives in the model-management layer, not inside model implementations.
class ModelPatcher at comfy/model_patcher.py#L340 owns model patching; ModelPatcherDynamic subclasses it at L1752.
Sampler base class and KSAMPLER implement sampling; nodes.py exposes KSampler/KSamplerAdvanced (L1597-L1626) as user-facing nodes.
LatentFormat base class with SD15 and SDXL subclasses defines per-model-family latent layouts.
comfy/quant_ops.py defines quantized weight layout classes (TensorCoreMXFP8Layout, TensorCoreNVFP4Layout, TensorCoreFP8 layouts) built on comfy-kitchen layout bases.
